nodes.title: Web App Entry HTML
nodes.summary: Single-page application HTML shell for Pāvati Pustak. Provides the root div mount point, loads the React entry module (src/main.tsx), and declares PWA manifest, favicon, theme-color, and meta description.
nodes.description: Standard Vite/React SPA index.html. Contains minimal markup: a <div id='root'> container and a module script loading /src/main.tsx. Head includes charset, viewport, theme-color (#f97316 orange), SEO description, manifest link for PWA support, and favicon reference to /logo.png.
nodes.languageNotes: HTML5 doctype with lang='en'. Uses Vite-style absolute imports from public/ directory (manifest.webmanifest, logo.png). Module script tag points to TypeScript source directly — Vite handles transpilation at dev time.
nodes.languageLesson: Vite serves index.html as the app entry and resolves <script type='module'> src paths through its dev server and build pipeline. The public/ directory assets (logo.png, manifest.webmanifest) are served at root without bundling.

nodes.title: Web App Package Manifest
nodes.summary: npm package definition for the @pavati/web app. Defines Vite-based dev/build/preview/typecheck scripts and declares React 19, react-router-dom, TanStack Query, Zustand, Recharts, react-hook-form + Zod, Tailwind CSS v4, and internal workspace packages as dependencies.
nodes.description: Private ESM package (@pavati/web v0.1.0) for the web frontend. Scripts: dev (vite), build (tsc -b && vite build), preview (vite preview), typecheck (tsc -b --noEmit). Runtime dependencies include React 19, react-dom, react-router-dom v7, @tanstack/react-query v5, zustand v5, recharts v2, react-hook-form v7 with @hookform/resolvers, zod v3, sonner for toasts, clsx, date-fns, lucide-react icons, @fontsource/mukta font, and workspace packages @pavati/receipt-engine and @pavati/shared. Dev dependencies: Tailwind CSS v4 with Vite plugin, @types/react, @types/react-dom, @vitejs/plugin-react, TypeScript 5.6, Vite 6.
nodes.languageNotes: JSON with comments stripped. Uses caret (^) version ranges for all dependencies. Internal packages reference workspace root via '*' version specifier. ESM-only (type: module). Private field prevents accidental publish.
nodes.languageLesson: The monorepo uses npm/yarn/pnpm workspaces with '*' protocol for inter-package dependencies. Tailwind CSS v4 uses a Vite plugin instead of the legacy PostCSS approach. Zustand v5 replaces Redux for client state management. TanStack Query v5 provides server-state caching.

nodes.title: Web App TypeScript Configuration
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the web app. Targets ES2022, enables strict mode with additional checks (noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters, noFallthroughCasesInSwitch), uses react-jsx transform, Bundler module resolution, and includes only the src/ directory.
nodes.description: TypeScript config targeting ES2022 with DOM and DOM.Iterable libs. Key settings: useDefineForClassFields (ES2022 class field semantics), Bundler moduleResolution (for Vite compatibility), isolatedModules (for SWC/esbuild compatibility), noEmit (type-checking only, Vite handles bundling), jsx: react-jsx (automatic JSX transform). Strict mode enabled with additional lint-equivalent checks. Vite client types included via types array. Only src/ directory included in compilation.
nodes.languageNotes: Bundler moduleResolution is the recommended setting for Vite — it resolves bare specifiers via package.json exports but falls back to file-based resolution for non-packaged imports. isolatedModules ensures each file can be transpiled independently by esbuild/SWC without type information.
nodes.languageLesson: noEmit: true means tsc is used only for type-checking, not code generation — Vite's esbuild handles the actual transpilation. The react-jsx transform eliminates the need to import React in every JSX file. Bundler module resolution (introduced in TS 5.0) is the modern replacement for 'node' resolution in bundler contexts.
